title: AI POD subsystem 04 - Storage (Everpure FlashBlade + XFM)
description:
Stub schema for the storage subsystem on Everpure FlashBlade//S with XFM aggregation switches (pair of 1RU switches that aggregate multiple FlashBlade chassis to scale storage incrementally). Replace with the real shape when automation lands; until then, any object is accepted so the composed inventory can include this subsystem.

Vendor-named per the locked subsystem table (D11/S1). Future storage variants land as peer subsystems (storage-netapp, storage-vast, etc.) for partner-ownership clarity.
